sentences.text: In a faraway kingdom, the people were poor.
Then the king came up with an idea... one he thought was absolutely brilliant.
Print tons of money and give it to everyone! Hahaha!"
"I'm rich! I'm rich! Tomorrow I'm buying a car!"
But when everyone suddenly had lots of money, the amount of bread and rice... stayed the same.
"Sorry, sir. Bread just went up... oh, up again... oh, up again!"
"This morning, this money could buy a goat... now it only gets me bread! Huhuhu..."
"Ahem... I'll just switch off the printing machine for now..."
This isn't just a fairy tale.
More money, same goods, and prices skyrocketed.
Prices could double in just one day!
They even printed a one hundred trillion bill!
In the end, that money was no longer used, and the country switched to foreign currency.
The funny part? Today, that one hundred trillion bill sells to collectors... for more than it was worth back then!
Can you guess which country it was?
And if you had one hundred trillion, what would you buy?
